newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM Oaky Creek workers to return.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM Oaky Creek workers to return.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that miners at the group's Oaky Creek coal mine who have been on strike since last Thursday will resume work this afternoon.
"Workers at Oaky Creek will resume this afternoon," MIM general manager, corporate affairs, Collin Myers told Reuters.
The construction, forestry, mining and energy union (CFMEU) said earlier the dispute was over a letter to the mine's 500-strong workforce last Wednesday.
The letter notified employees the company would revert to award conditions and cease to abide by customs and agreements at the mine from November 23, the union said.
The dispute was referred to the Industrial Relations Commission and has been the subject of a closed hearing.
Myers said production has been lost at the Oaky Creek mine, but declined to reveal how much.
Oaky Creek produces nearly three million tonnes of high-quality coking coal annually for markets in India, Asia and Europe.
